checks.test: const m = $$('main, [role="main"]'); return m.length === 1 && m[0].textContent.includes('Harbour Lights 2026') && m[0].textContent.includes('Weekend pass');

const h = $('header'); if (!h || h.closest('main, article, aside, nav, section')) return false; const nav = $('nav'); return !!nav && h.contains(nav) && nav.textContent.includes('Events') && nav.textContent.includes('Account');
const f = $('footer'); return !!f && !f.closest('main, article, aside, nav, section') && f.textContent.includes('Terms');
const h1 = $$('h1'); return h1.length === 1 && h1[0].textContent.trim() === 'Harbour Lights 2026';

const hs = $$('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6'); const names = hs.map((h) => h.textContent.trim()); if (!['Line-up', 'Tickets', 'Friday pass', 'Weekend pass'].every((n) => names.includes(n))) return false; const lv = hs.map((h) => Number(h.tagName[1])); if (lv[0] !== 1) return false; for (let i = 1; i < lv.length; i++) if (lv[i] - lv[i - 1] > 1) return false; const lvl = (n) => lv[names.indexOf(n)]; return lvl('Friday pass') === lvl('Tickets') + 1 && lvl('Line-up') === lvl('Tickets');
